rows: POST /par + POST /payments/file-payments — payment reference charset (OFP-003, MERGED)
v2.1-errata3 (content changed)

The payment-reference charset pattern proposed in OFP-003 (approved 1 Jul, decision DR-2026-003) has MERGED to main: AECreditorReference/AEDebtorReference (and Bank Service Initiation Consent RAR variants) now enforce the ISO 20022/SWIFT ‘x’ character set (`^[A-Za-z0-9 /?:().,’+-]+$`) on POST /par, POST /payments and POST /file-payments -- previously these were unconstrained free text.

TPPs sending a Creditor/Debtor reference containing a character outside the agreed set (e.g. @, #, %, <, >, accented Latin) now receive a request-validation error at the API Hub. Sanitise/transliterate references to the agreed set before submission.

NEW: Standards V2.2 draft — consent Attestations sub-resource (all 3 domains)
v2.2-rc1 / v2.2.x (NEW, draft)

Every consent (account-access, payment, insurance) gains an append-only `.../attestations` sub-resource: once a consent reaches a terminal status (Revoked/Expired/Consumed) the TPP POSTs an Attestation Event declaring what it did with the data held (Deleted/Retained/Anonymised/ArchivedRestricted), within 45 days. Confirmed in the raw spec diff (GET/POST added to account-information, bank-initiation and insurance specs) and on the website's new v2.1→v2.2-draft changelog.
TPPs will need to implement the attestation POST for every consent type once V2.2 is finalised (Tier-1 mandate Dec-2026). No action yet -- still draft, not on a published version.
https://github.com/Nebras-Open-Finance/api-specs/blob/main/dist/standards/v2.2-rc1/uae-account-information-openapi.yaml
NEW: Standards V2.2 draft — payment settlement rail + paginated payment log
v2.2-rc1 / v2.2.x (NEW, draft)

Consent Manager gains `paymentResponse.paymentRail` (AANI/FTS/LFI), REQUIRED on any terminal-success PATCH /payment-log/{id} -- flagged by Nebras as ‘the one change in v2.2 that requires action from every LFI’. GET /payment-log becomes paginated (page/pageSize), replacing the v2.1 full-list response.
LFIs: must populate paymentRail on terminal-success payment-log patches, and must page through GET /payment-log (a v2.1-built caller that reads only the first page will silently under-report volume).
https://github.com/Nebras-Open-Finance/api-specs/blob/main/dist/api-hub/v2.2.x/uae-api-hub-consent-manager-openapi.yaml
NEW: Standards V2.2 draft — transaction narrative required; CoP simplified
v2.2-rc1 / v2.2.x (NEW, draft)

TransactionInformation/transactionInformation becomes REQUIRED on both the TPP-facing and Ozone Connect transaction schemas (min/maxLength 1–500) -- an LFI returning transactions with no narrative will fail validation. Confirmation of Payee is simplified: the request drops the submitted name (IBAN-only lookup); the response drops the verifiedClaims/verification identity-assurance envelope and wide customer PII, settling on a direct name field.
LFIs must derive a human-readable narrative for every transaction (no placeholders) and simplify their CoP integration to the IBAN-in / name-out contract once V2.2 is finalised.
https://nebras-open-finance.com/tech/release-notes-and-erratas/changelog/v2.2-draft/
